title: By two years, most children try switches, knobs, or buttons on a toy
summary: The CDC says that by two years, most children try to use switches, knobs, or buttons on a toy.
body: The CDC's cognitive list for two years includes trying to use switches, knobs, or buttons on a toy. The page groups the item with learning and problem solving. It is what the page says most children do by a second birthday, on the US list. The line is not a claim that every button toy is safe. The item is about making a toy respond, and it does not declare every toy safe.

sources.title: Milestones by 2 Years
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US CDC page, public domain. Updated and reviewed 16 May 2026. Supports the cognitive item 'Tries to use switches, knobs, or buttons on a toy.'
